teaching: When conventional conceptions are forgotten to be conventional and taken for objective facts that no one questions, narrow-minded bigotry and blind prejudice develop unopposed: bigotry is a closed mind, locked into one way of conceiving things, when our whole view of the world is conditioned by our environment (Tao Te Ching, Chapter 2, Thomas Cleary's notes).
youtube_title: You Can Be Bigoted on the Right, Left or Center
